verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business documentation says users can set up call routing and call forwarding, and that incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once or roll to other numbers when unanswered. That covers sending the business number to a cell when nobody picks up at the desk, and the mobile app also lets staff answer business calls from anywhere. Missing for 10: explicit forwarding to an external cell number or schedule/time-of-day rules, in-depth setup documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
